lines.t: Yo, the page turns, light burns,
Truth speakin’—every falsehood learns,
This is that True Dat’ sermon,
Where shadows get nervous, yeah—let’s go!
I step in the ring with scrolls and clarity,
Modern Pharisees caught in parody,
Talkin’ peace but sowin’ disparity,
I’m bringin’ light, pure sincerity.
They chase gold like it's salvation,
Claim devotion—pure imitation,
I spit revelation, no hesitation,
Bars built on divine calibration.
I’m that trumpet blazin’ thunder in rhyme,
They counterfeit truth one lie at a time,
But the Word got rhythm, perfect in design,
So I battle with wisdom, every line divine.
Truth slaps harder when the veil gets torn,
Fake fall flat when the light gets born,
No disguise, no mask, no show,
What’s hidden in the dark always bound to glow.
Truth slaps harder when the lies run dry,
You can’t outtalk the Voice from on high,
Real recognize real, that’s law—
True Dat’ Battle for the Word I saw.
I see preachers with sneakers, flexin’ brand tags,
While the humble kneel low with paper bags.
I don’t need hype, I don’t need fame,
Every line I write put deception to shame.
Prophets in hoodies, the streets still listen,
Truth ain’t polished, it’s grit and mission.
They scroll for likes, I scroll for grace,
Droppin’ verses straight from a higher place.
False crowns crumble like dust to dawn,
When the real steps up, pretenders gone.
No gimmicks, no clout, no fraud—
Just mic, message, rhythm, and God.
Truth slaps harder when the veil gets torn,
Fake fall flat when the light gets born,
No disguise, no mask, no show,
What’s hidden in the dark always bound to glow.
Truth slaps harder when the lies run dry,
You can’t outtalk the Voice from on high,
Real recognize real, that’s law—
True Dat’ Battle for the Word I saw.
This the courtroom of spirit and sound,
Every false prophet get taken down.
I ain’t tossin’ shade, I’m exposin’ the gray,
If you know The Volumes, you know the way.
Truth in the rhyme, light in the drum,
Every beat a beacon till the Kingdom come.
Boom Bap the gospel, sub-bass thunder,
Let every mask fall, let the proud go under.
[instrumental fade]
